title: English Practice Quiz 0997
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A 'receipt' is a document that ___.
questions.explanation: A receipt is written proof that money or goods were received.

questions.question: If the payment arrives today, we ___ the order immediately.
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses present simple in the if-clause and will or a present-tense main clause.

questions.question: A 'budget' is a plan for ___.
questions.explanation: A budget estimates income and planned spending.

questions.question: Which question asks politely about a bank charge?
options: Could you explain this service charge, please?
questions.explanation: This question is polite and identifies the charge that needs explanation.

questions.question: The total cost, including taxes, ___ shown on the invoice.
questions.explanation: The subject total cost is singular, so it takes is.

questions.question: To 'withdraw' money means to ___.
options: take money out of an account
questions.explanation: Withdraw means remove money from an account.

questions.question: A product costs 800 rupees. A 10% discount is ___.
She has been working here ___ six months.
questions.explanation: For is used with a duration such as six months.

questions.question: An ' instalment' is ___.
questions.explanation: An instalment is one part of a payment made over time.

questions.question: Which closing is suitable for a formal business email?
questions.explanation: Yours sincerely is a conventional formal email or letter closing.
